div.div: مَدُوفٌ (T, S, M, Msb, K) and مَدْوُوفٌ, (S, M, Msb, K,) the latter of the dial. of Temeem, (M,) and [said to be] the only instance of the kind, (S, Msb, K,) i. e., of a pass. part. n. of a triliteralradical verb with a medial و (S, Msb, * TA,) except مَصُوونٌ (S, Msb, K) as a variation of مَصُونٌ, (S, Msb,) though Mbr asserts it to be agreeable with a rule obtaining in all similar cases, which none [other] of the leading authorities allows, (Msb,) and مَدُوفٌ and مَصُونٌ are the usual forms, (S, TA,) Mixed: (M, Msb:) or moistened: or bruised, brayed, or pounded; or powdered, or pulverized: (S, K:) applied to perfume, (T,) or to musk: (S, M, K:) as also ↓ دَائِفٌ . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
